name: todo-list-ui
description: Create a todo list UI component with add, remove, and toggle functionality

promptLevels.beginner: make a todo list where you can add and remove items
promptLevels.intermediate: create a TodoList class that stores todo items and has methods to add, remove, and mark items as complete
promptLevels.advanced: write a TodoList class that manages an array of todo objects (each with id, text, completed), with methods to add new todos, remove by id, toggle completion status by id, and get filtered lists (all/active/completed)
promptLevels.expert: Write a TodoList class that manages a collection of todo items. Each todo should be an object with: id (unique number), text (string), and completed (boolean). The class should maintain an internal array of todos and provide these methods: 1) add(text) - creates a new todo with a unique id and completed=false, adds it to the array. 2) remove(id) - removes the todo with matching id from the array. 3) toggle(id) - flips the completed status of the todo with matching id. 4) getAll() - returns all todos. 5) getActive() - returns only todos where completed=false. 6) getCompleted() - returns only todos where completed=true. The class should handle id generation (incrementing counter or similar) to ensure each todo has a unique id. {languageSpecific}

languageInstructions.typescript: Use TypeScript with a Todo interface defining id (number), text (string), and completed (boolean). The class should have proper type annotations for all methods and the internal todos array. Export both the Todo interface and the TodoList class.
languageInstructions.javascript: Create a TodoList class with a constructor that initializes an empty todos array and an idCounter starting at 1. Implement all methods using array methods like push, filter, find, and map. Export the class as default export.
languageInstructions.javascript-jsdoc: Use JSDoc with @typedef for the Todo object structure (id, text, completed), @class for TodoList, @property for the todos array, @param for method parameters, and @returns for method return types (Todo[], Todo, void, etc.). Export the class.

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript TodoList class that manages todo items with add, remove, toggle, and filter methods. Include proper interfaces and type annotations.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript TodoList class that manages todo items with add, remove, toggle, and filter methods.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript TodoList class with JSDoc type annotations that manages todo items with add, remove, toggle, and filter methods.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Create a complete vanilla JavaScript todo list application. Include:

**HTML Structure:**
- Input field for new todos
- Add button
- List container for todos
- Each todo item has: checkbox, text, delete button
- Filter buttons (All, Active, Completed)

**CSS Styling:**
- Clean, modern design
- Completed todos have strikethrough
- Hover effects on buttons
- Responsive layout

**JavaScript Functionality:**
- Add new todos
- Toggle todo completion (checkbox)
- Delete todos
- Filter todos (all/active/completed)
- Use localStorage to persist todos
- All vanilla JavaScript, no frameworks

Return as a single HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Create a complete vanilla JavaScript todo list application with JSDoc annotations. Include:

**All the same requirements as javascript-vanilla-web, plus:**
- Complete JSDoc type definitions
- @typedef for Todo type
- @param and @return tags on all functions
- Document the state structure

Return as a single HTML file.
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Create a todo list using TypeScript with vanilla Web APIs. Include:

**TypeScript Code:**
- Interface for Todo type (id, text, completed, createdAt)
- Class or functions to manage todos
- Proper TypeScript types throughout
- DOM manipulation with typed event handlers
- LocalStorage with proper typing

**HTML Structure:**
- Input and add button
- Todo list container
- Filter buttons

**Features:**
- Add, remove, toggle todos
- Filter by status
- Persist to localStorage
- No frameworks

Provide TypeScript source and HTML structure.
variants.typescript-react:
Create a todo list application using TypeScript React. Include:

**Components:**
- TodoApp (main component)
- TodoInput (for adding todos)
- TodoList (list container)
- TodoItem (individual todo)
- TodoFilters (filter buttons)

**Features:**
- Add todos
- Toggle completion
- Delete todos
- Filter (all/active/completed)
- Persist with localStorage

**TypeScript:**
- Interface for Todo type
- Proper component prop types
- Type-safe state management
- No external state libraries (just useState/useEffect)

Minimal dependencies (React only, no UI libraries).
